messages:
marta ivanova: saw noisy bursts on SLO during rollout. idea: console should surface a compact 'playbook preview' recommending temporary knobs (soft-snooze, fingerprint-merge, route-attenuation) and show replayed impact before apply.
samir patel: yes. replay numbers are a must. owners won't trust a suggestion without historical proof.
jun li: telemetry needed: per-route alert timeline, unique-fingerprint ratio, incident clustering. replay should be bounded (max 30d).
olivia king: UX: compact card on SLO page with tabs: Preview (numbers), Rules (diff), Audit (who can approve). CTAs: [Run Replay] [Preview Rules] [Request Apply].
marta ivanova: default = preview-only; require explicit owner approval to persist. include impact estimates: "alerts prevented/hr" and "possible missed-escalations (%)" with confidence band.
samir patel: API sketch: POST /api/v1/slo/:id/playbook-suggestions -> returns suggestion id. POST /api/v1/replays -> returns job id + summary. include meta.confidence and sample events.
jun li: RBAC: only SLO owners and ops-admins can apply; teams can request replays. audit log must show diffs. also call out multi-tenant route exceptions in the RFC.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: playbook-preview service deployed to staging Thu 02:15 UTC.
marta ivanova: next: samir drafts API + schema, jun scopes replay infra, olivia mocks card, i'll draft RFC. drop edge cases here (quota interactions, tenant overrides).
